newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ZWACK SAYS 9-MONTH RESULTS IN LINE WITH PLANS.
newsitem.headline: ZWACK SAYS 9-MONTH RESULTS IN LINE WITH PLANS.

text.p: Hungarian spirits maker Zwack Unicum Rt said on Thursday that its sales and pre-tax profits in the January-September period were in line with its plans.

Zwack released its nine-month consolidated IAS results this morning and said its gross sales revenues rose to 9.871 billion forints from 8.352 billion in the same period of 1995 while its 377 million forints pre-tax profit was up by 60 million.
The company said that Hungary's illegal alcohol sales continued to have a negative impact on its domestic sales.
"The legal alcohol market continued to shrink and our domestic sales in volumes were 1.8 percent below that in the same period of last year," Zwack said in its results report.
The group has generated 458 million forints from exports although it saw a setback in its sales to the countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States due to changes in import rules there.
This 458 million forints of export revenue represented 77.4 percent of exports in the whole year of 1995, and accounted for 7.93 percent of total net sales in the first nine months of 1996, it said.
The group's costs were also in line with plans with the exception of delivery costs.
Zwack said the group's investments reached an accumulated 356 million forints during the nine months.
"The implementation of main projects are in line with plans and the test production in the new distillery in Kecskemet will start in November."
